about: The control request apply_flag_settings on CLI 2.1.312 (Claude Code), in a -p --input-format stream-json session started with --allowedTools=mcp__x__argv_rule, --strict-mcp-config and --setting-sources= under an empty CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR; no turn sent, no tokens spent. Each step is the request and what list_permission_rules answered after it. Recorded 2026-10-30.
findings: The rules of permissions.allow go to the session's flag layer, listed with source 'flagSettings' and editability 'readonly'.
A second request replaces the flag layer's allow list: allow [] removes the rules the first one added.
The rules of --allowedTools (source 'cliArg') are left alone by either request.
